draft.subject: Re: AXA insurance coverage question
draft.body:

- Check-up and consultation: ₺900
- Composite filling (per tooth): ₺2,000 – ₺3,500 depending on size

If you would like to book a check-up and filling next month, just reply and we will find a morning slot for you.

Warm regards,

- Kimliğiniz

Size uygun bir randevu saati ayarlamamızı isterseniz, tercih ettiğiniz gün ve saati yazmanız yeterli.

Sevgiyle,
Nova Dental Clinic reception

draft.body:

Thank you for getting in touch, and I'm sorry you're in pain.

Swelling together with toothache is worth taking seriously, so please let us know as soon as possible. We keep same-day slots for urgent cases like yours. If the swelling spreads, you develop a fever, or the pain keeps you awake, please contact the clinic right away, or seek urgent medical care if it is severe or you have trouble breathing or swallowing.

I'm not able to give personal medication advice by email, so for questions about ibuprofen or which compress to use, please ask our dentist or reception team when you call. Your current appointment is still in place, but if you would like to be seen sooner, reply with two or three preferred days and we will look for an earlier time.

Warm regards,
Nova Dental Clinic reception

We'd also appreciate a call or email if you know you'll be running behind. That lets us adjust your visit or plan around it, so you get the best possible appointment.

If you have any other questions, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Nova Dental Clinic reception

If you can't reach the emergency line or the pain becomes severe, or you have swelling, bleeding or difficulty breathing or swallowing, please go to your nearest hospital emergency department.

Once we are open, please call us or reply here and we will find you the earliest available appointment so our team can see you.

Warm regards,
